summary: v44.00.01 backend regression — 18/18 tests passed on first full run. Verified IP-lock on POST /api/plugin/verify-license (first-IP auto-lock + different-IP rejection with reason=ip_not_allowed), LicenseViolation logging with browser_ip + whm_server_ip fields, tenant isolation on /api/stats/traffic and /api/dashboard/top-domains between master (MS-C02AB012652A4FE692D69676) and starter reseller (MS-TESTBAYI-STARTER-V4371), master-only gating on /api/master/alerts (empty for non-master), plugin tarball download (200, gzip, contains VERSION file with v44.00.01), heartbeat via POST /api/license/heartbeat, and regression on /stats/overview, /licenses, /logs, /payments/settings, /master/status, /master/check. Wrong license key returns 404 (accepted). All recent tenant-isolation & IP-lock backend changes are working correctly with no regressions.

endpoints_tested.verify_license: POST /api/plugin/verify-license (IP auto-lock + reject different IP + violation record + wrong key)
endpoints_tested.violations_list: GET /api/license/violations (master listing) — used because there is NO /api/master/violations route; both routes/master.py and server.py confirmed. Violations flow through db.license_violations + db.violations collections.
endpoints_tested.heartbeat: POST /api/license/heartbeat (there is NO /api/plugin/heartbeat route; correct path is /api/license/heartbeat per server.py:6794)
endpoints_tested.master_gating: GET /api/master/alerts (returns empty items for non-master callers; full payload for master via X-Master-Key header)

minor.issue: Endpoint has NO tenant/master gating — any unauthenticated caller can list ALL licenses (including master + every reseller). Data leak risk. This is likely PRE-EXISTING (not part of the v44 changes) but should be gated with _is_master.
Also unauthenticated — any caller can list all license violations (contains license_keys, browser/whm IPs). Consider requiring X-Master-Key.

Wrong-license-key path returns 404 with only 'Lisans bulunamadı' message and does NOT write a LicenseViolation row for reason=key_not_found (spec item 1c expects violation logged for wrong key). Only revoked / ip_not_allowed paths write violations.

Payload has no explicit server_ip field — the ip field is documented as 'public IP of the plugin host' and doubles as WHM server IP. The client is expected to pass browser IP via X-Forwarded-For (or socket) and server IP via body.ip; violation.raw records both. Documented behaviour, not a bug, but worth confirming with the CGI iframe change.

action_items: Add violation-logging for reason='key_not_found' in POST /api/plugin/verify-license when license_key is present but no match (spec 1c). Currently only ip_not_allowed and license_revoked paths write to db.license_violations.
Consider gating GET /api/licenses and GET /api/license/violations behind _is_master() — currently they return all rows to any caller (potential PII / tenant leak).
There is no /api/master/violations route (as hinted in the request). If the spec calls for one, add it; otherwise document that /api/license/violations is the canonical route.
Heartbeat route is /api/license/heartbeat (not /api/plugin/heartbeat). If plugin code is expected to hit /plugin/heartbeat, add an alias.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 12k+ lines — split verify-license/heartbeat/download into routes/plugin.py (already exists but underused).

verify-license auto-locks on first IP without any auth — anyone with a leaked license_key can lock it to their IP first. Consider requiring hostname+NS check for first-lock, or a signed installer token.

browser_ip extraction uses only x-forwarded-for header — behind Kubernetes ingress this is trusted but any middleware/config change would let a caller spoof it. Add X-Real-IP fallback and document trust boundary.
